asr.full_text: In the next few minutes, you will discover a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create true financial freedom without the need to recruit hundreds of people and also without regular monthly payments that can drain your bank account and profits. Okay, so you may be wondering, what is digital currency and how can you benefit financially from it? When bitcoin first arrived on the scene back in 2009, 1 Bitcoin was valued at just 10 cents. As more bitcoins were mined , the value gradually increased. At one time, the value of 1 Bitcoin reached over a thousand one hundred dollars.
